pages.title: Complete the chapter
pages.text:
1\. Open the quest screen and work through Soil. Read each task: some need you to hold an item; others ask you to craft or perform an action.\
2\. Claim the **Soil Knot** reward when its tasks are complete.\
3\. Craft and place a **Tension Post** using its current recipe.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: 4\. Right-click the Post with the Soil Strand token.

pages.title: Check the Post
pages.text:
The Soil notch should light and your team gains the seated Strand. Completing a quest and seating its token are separate steps.\
If the notch stays dark, check that you claimed the token and are holding the right item. Team progress is shared; you do not need a separate Post for every player.

pages.title: Continue
